shared_elements: relief carving of figures against a plain ground
animals arranged in a row facing the same direction
anthropomorphic figure (small schematic figure in A, human figures in B)
justification: Both surfaces show profile quadrupeds carved in relief, aligned in a horizontal row moving in the same direction, and both include anthropomorphic forms, but these are generic conventions that any relief tradition might produce. The decisive difference is that B depicts a naturalistic procession of bearded men physically leading horned rams with detailed fleece and hands on the animals, while A shows stacked registers of schematic, disproportionate creatures (bird-like head, splayed limbs, abstract signs and a bucket-like object) with no comparable human-animal interaction.
